statement: Fares well early, particularly in Ironclad who does not have many 0-energy cards nor ways to gain energy, but in the late game you might find yourself not being able to spend all your energy each turn with too low-cost cards. As a freebie, it's ok, but rarely worth spending money on except in an emergency.

name: The Bomb
description: At the end of 3 turns, deal 40 damage to ALL enemies.
description_upgraded: At the end of 3 turns, deal 50 damage to ALL enemies.
statement: Although this card has the potential to one-shot an entire encounter, it takes 3 turns to pull off. If this card is in the bottom of your deck, you can end up needing 6-7 turns to finish the encounter, having not killed a single enemy until it triggers. This is because The Bomb is often picked alongside defensive cards in order to survive until the damage goes off. This often means you aren't drafting offensive cards to deal with enemies outside of The Bomb. This makes it particularly awkward versus bosses or other high health enemies, such as the Head, that need multiple plays of this card to kill. Best used with intangible effects.
